name: Liberty Bell
blurb: The granite bell that towers over Washington Pass, with a short approach straight from the highway.
permit: Northwest Forest Pass at the Blue Lake trailhead. The highway closes for winter, usually from November until spring.

routes.name: Beckey Route
routes.summary: A short hike from the Blue Lake trail, a loose gully to the notch between Liberty Bell and Concord Tower, then a chimney and slab to the top. Rappel or downclimb the route.
skills: Leading or following 5.6 in a chimney
Moving carefully in a loose gully with parties above

line.source: Placed by hand on terrain data and published route descriptions; not surveyed

waypoints.name: Climbers path
waypoints.note: Leave the Blue Lake trail where a well-worn path heads toward the spires.

sections.note: Blue Lake trail through forest to the climbers path.
Climbers path through meadow and talus to the base of the gully.
Loose gully to the notch. Parties above knock rocks down; wear a helmet from here.
Class 4 ledges, a 5.6 chimney and a slab to the summit.

pois.name: Washington Pass Overlook
pois.note: Roadside overlook with the classic view of Liberty Bell and the Early Winters Spires.
